SafeMath.safeAdd: c = a + b with require(c >= a) overflow guard.
SafeMath.safeSub: require(b <= a) then c = a - b underflow guard.
SafeMath.safeMul: c = a * b with require(a == 0 || c / a == b) overflow guard.
SafeMath.safeDiv: require(b > 0) then c = a / b division-by-zero guard.
Owned constructor: assigns owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner function storing _newOwner into newOwner, starting a two-step ownership transfer.
Completes ownership transfer when msg.sender == newOwner; emits OwnershipTransferred and clears newOwner.
KRTR constructor: sets symbol, name, decimals, mints _totalSupply to a hardcoded address and emits Transfer.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)] (burned tokens).
Returns balances[tokenOwner].
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd and emits Transfer.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval; no zero-then-set protection.
Moves tokens from 'from' to 'to' using msg.sender's allowance via safeSub/safeAdd; external-call free but allowance decrement ordering is state dependent.
Returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets allowance then performs an external call to spender.receiveApproval(...) on an attacker-controlled contract.
Payable fallback that immediately reverts; contract refuses plain ETH.
onlyOwner rescue function that performs an external call to an arbitrary ERC20 contract transferring tokens to owner.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, balance and allowance keys, and token source.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) to an untrusted contract while allowance state is already written.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an arbitrary caller-supplied contract.
